Ally stun (.stun 1) and ally mark (.tag on ally) have no direct mod precedent — inferred from ally-targeted effect writes (experimental).

Group stun once-per-target resolution and post-stun resistance ladder pending A12.

Implemented as one extra action in the casting round, per_battle_limit 1. A14 experiment (hero info initiative constant) remains the only candidate for the full design; do NOT promote to permanent double actions.
